items.title: Drafting the Top Players to Start a Franchise with in 2026: Part 2 | Third Apron Podcast
items.body_excerpt: John Gonzalez of CBS Sports joins the show to help us draft the best players to start a franchise with. We took turns selecting players in a three-team snake draft. You can follow Yossi on: Twitter: https://twitter.com/YossiGozlan BlueSky:…
